text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kyun kyun kyun kyun kyun kyun! "Let's stay 
together forever and eeevvver♡"
(*Siiiiiiiilence*)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Wait!! Aren't there way too few people 
here, like, seriously!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
*sighhhhh*... Revitalizing a town never 
goes quite as planned, does it...

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
We've run through the PDCA cycle, clearly 
identified our target demographics... But 
repeat visitors are clearly lacking, so... 
perhaps the objective is too vague?

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is transport the issue~... Ah, no, 
wait! Is our marketing approach wrong~!? 
Aaargh, what on earth should we do~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you overthinking this whole thing? 
Basically, as long as it's fun, it's all 
good, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Let's just make it crazy fun! If we do 
that, people will definitely come, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, decided! The great genius 
Pandora-chan will pitch some awesome ideas 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey hey! Let's turn this entire food 
court into an all-you-can-eat buffet~♪ 
There are sooo many things I wanna eat♡

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
What!? Every shop and price point is 
completely different, you know!? Putting 
all of that together into a buffet would 
be...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but still! It'll defiiinitely be fun! 
Come on, let's do it~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn this spot into an amusement 
park! Set up roller coasters, a Ferris 
wheel, all that!

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
An amusement park...!? We don't even have 
that kind of land!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh, but an amusement park would be so 
good~~ It'd be tons of fun, guaranteed! 
...A zoo at least, then.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, you're making such complicated 
faces~. Think about it carefully, wouldn't 
it be totally amazing!?

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
............ S-Sure, imagining it sounds 
fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's a nice onsen right here! Why 
don't we turn this into a heated pool 
water park?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
We could make a lazy river kind of thing! 
Oh, and float flowers in it! Drifting 
along would make everyone feel so 
luxurious♪

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
...Pandora-san, your ideas really are 
filled with nothing but pure fun.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh! If it's not fun, nobody's gonna 
want to come!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I want to turn this town into a place 
packed with sparkle and fun, just like a 
magical treasure box!

One day, I used my time off to visit a 
tourist spot that had been buzzing with 
hype.

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
This mini-buffet is the best~! It tastes 
so good, I'm definitely buying the 
full-size version!

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
—Go on, have fun on the inflatable 
playground. There are still lots of 
attractions you haven't played on, right?

text_block_list.name: Tourist C
text_block_list.text:
But, but, I wanna see those animal statues 
over there! Let's go see them together, 
pleeease!!
choice_data_list: (The kids are having a blast too...!)

text_block_list.name: Tourist D
text_block_list.text:
Turning hot spring water into a heated 
pool was such a brilliant idea!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, if it isn't Tracen Academy's 
Trainer! Having fun? Yeahhh!
choice_data_list: Are you also here for sightseeing?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sightseeing, or more like... an 
invitation? As a thank-you for helping out 
with everything~.

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
...Truly, your skill was remarkable. 
Thanks to you, this place has become a 
wonderful tourist destination.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no sweat~♡ ...Well, I am genius 
Pandora-chan after all!

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...Once again, I've learned a 
valuable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
I was so focused on adhering strictly to 
standard formulas that I forgot what was 
truly important.

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
—Create something that you yourself find 
truly enjoyable from the bottom of your 
heart. That was the real starting point.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! Right now, you look super 
sparkly!

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...D-Do I, really?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ ...Well, with the power of this 
genius Pandora-chan, success was the only 
option anyway!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...I'll come visit again when I'm free♪ 
I'll bring the other girls along too, all 
of us!

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
...Pandora-san. Truly, thank you so very 
much for everything.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't mention it~... But hey. There's 
just one thing I gotta say~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it still not quite enough!? 
Shouldn't we make it way, waaay more 
sparkly?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Let's set up illuminations! Make the whole 
town dazzling and bright! Then invite 
luxury brand stores, and make it a town 
that's super easy to shop in!

text_block_list.name: Tourism Expert
text_block_list.text:
...P-Pandora-san. Asking for the 
impossible again...!

And so, the revitalization accomplished in 
this town became a model for numerous 
local governments to follow.
